title: HR Business Partner: Roles, Responsibilities and Competencies
overview: The role of an HR Business Partner (HRBP) varies widely across organizations, often leading to confusion about its true purpose and responsibilities. This course aims to clarify the HRBP function by offering insights based on best practices in modern HR management. Participants will gain a clear understanding of the HRBP role, along with the essential skills and competencies needed to effectively contribute to business success. The course focuses on how HR business partners can add strategic value by aligning HR initiatives with broader organizational objectives.
audience: This course is ideal for HR professionals responsible for aligning business goals with employee and management needs in specific business units. It is also valuable for line managers or business leaders looking to better understand how to leverage the strategic and consulting expertise offered by HR business partners.
methodology: Delivered in a highly interactive workshop format, this course encourages participants to explore the various roles and responsibilities of modern HR business partners. Attendees will engage in practical exercises and discussions aimed at developing the competencies needed to succeed in the HRBP role.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the evolving role of the HR business partner as the "architect of the talent machine"
Identify how HR business partners can drive value and support the achievement of organizational goals
Describe the four core roles of the HR business partner and their responsibilities
Apply these roles to real-world situations to enhance HR's contribution to business success
Develop and demonstrate key competencies required for effective HRBP performance
